review_candidates.title: Oracle Fusion Finance Techno Functional Consultant
review_candidates.description_excerpt: In this role, you will be responsible for developing end-to-end integrations between Oracle Fusion Financials and external source systems, building complex BI Publisher (BIP) reports, and providing critical functional and troubleshooting support across core finance modules. Key Responsibilities : Technical Development & Integration Architect, build, and maintain real-time and batch integrations between Oracle Fusion Financials and upstream/downstream source systems using Oracle Integration Cloud
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Expertise in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and SQL/PL-SQL is required, with hands-on experience in Oracle APEX highly recommended. Analyze business requirements to translate finance business logic into robust technical architectures and integration patterns. Required Qualifications & Skills : Solid hands-on experience working with Oracle Applications, with at least 2+ years dedicated to Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials. Technical Depth: Advanced proficiency in Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, and database performance tuning. Strong hands-on experience building complex BIP Reports (custom data models, multi-level grouping, bursting) and OTBI dashboards.
